[quote=nederlandse_staat;60283467][b]aid to the argossians[/b]
With the civil war in Astanir ongoing a debate started in parliament whether to intervene or not. Some factions like the Christian democrats and centrists wanted to stay out of it while the socialists and social democrats wanted to support the opposition. With the tension between each political party rising each minute and to avoid a political crisis the largest party in parliament, the NIP proposes to support the Argossian Militias instead of the Democratic Army of Astanir or the Armed restoration front. Every party except the VC agreed with the plan and voted in favor of sending military advisors to the aborginals and  preparations of bombing both the pro-junta and pro-democracy factions.
[nation]Astanir[/nation][/quote]

Please explain to me how you benefit from supporting the aboriginal factions? I thought you would benefit more from the democratic faction, but also how in the hell does this war have anything to do with you. You are nowhere in the vicinity of this nation and the result likely does not affect your country in any way, direct nor indirect. For example:

Pantagruel is intervening to support his fellow amaralans who have said they will place a pro-pantagruel government in place

Qianxun is intervening to spread his socialist ideology further out

Nordiheim is intervening to help his Argossian brothers gain independence.

Notice these three are also in the relative vicinity of Astanir and all have goals to achieve in this war, which prompted their intervention.

You on the other hand are half way across the world, have no diplomatic ties to Astanir and are a middle-powered nation with influence around Vespuria and elseyr, but not much else. You do not have any reason to intervene in this war and therefore [b]I am voiding this intervention.[/b]
